title: Commodity decision review
description: Append-only commodity outcome review. Version 1.0 preserves legacy single-action checkpoints. Version 2.0 grades one tactical or strategic forecast from its immutable archived decision on the forecast's exact target date and reconciles implementable total return from price, roll, collateral, fees and FX. Two horizons remain two observations under one decision ID, never two independent headline calls.

pointInTimeSource.description: Immutable source identity for one realised-return or path input. Observation and publication cannot be later than the forecast target; retrieval cannot be later than the review filing date.

original_confidence.description: Copied verbatim from decision_record.json's own confidence (a required, always-numeric field there — frameworks/commodity/decision_record.schema.json). Required here for the same reason: the command instructs the reviewer to pull it, and the calibration loop needs the copied conviction to ask whether high-confidence calls were actually calibrated. validate_screener_json.py cross-checks this value against the frozen record's confidence.

reference_price.description: Copied verbatim from decision_record.json's own current_price — the fixed anchor every window measures from (never re-derived on a later review). validate_screener_json.py cross-checks value/currency/unit/as_of against the frozen record.

allOf.$comment: When the anchor price is known (a number), it must carry currency/unit/as_of — those are the exact keys validate_screener_json.py cross-checks against the frozen current_price, and an unlabelled number is uninterpretable (CLAUDE.md §15). Omit only for the explicit null case. minLength:1 on the labels themselves stops an empty string from satisfying 'required' as a placeholder.

review_price.description: The commodity's price as of review_date. null value with a caveat in notes if no verifiable source was found — never fabricated (present-but-null, never absent).

allOf.$comment: The review price is fetched live at review time, so a known value must carry currency/unit/as_of AND a source (CLAUDE.md §5 web sources must be dated/labelled; §15 no unlabelled number). A commodity quoted in the wrong unit (cents/bushel vs $/bushel) makes absolute_return_pct meaningless. Omit only for the explicit null (no verifiable source found) case. minLength:1 on the labels themselves stops an empty string from satisfying 'required' as a placeholder.

price_vs_levels.description: Checks review_price against decision_record.json's own key_levels (copied here, not re-derived).

risk_results.description: One entry per decision_record.json key_risks[] item.

action_outcome.description: Was the original Action verdict right, judged against what actually happened. 'not_applicable' is reserved for 'Research More' calls being reviewed purely on whether more data actually arrived (a directional judgment does not apply to a data-sufficiency verdict). Mirrors decision_record's pre_mortem_check.outcome_vs_verdict naming (frameworks/DECISION_LEDGER.md §8) — same discipline, same five-way honest split, applied to the Action verdict instead of the pre-mortem's verdict.

enum: good process / bad luck or too early

error_taxonomy.description: Populated only when the call went wrong. CLAUDE.md §20 + DECISION_LEDGER.md §12 taxonomy.

notes.description: Free text: web-source labels, boundary-case justification for action_outcome, anything that doesn't fit a typed field. Never used to smuggle an unlabeled number.
